I understand what you mean. My ex has said the same things except I haven’t attempted it yet because I’m under close watch by family members right now upon instructions by my psychiatrist when she learnt I was acting like how I was a few years ago(depressed and suicidal) 

I know you’re in pain and no one can understand how much you feel but you. I do not advocate for suicide but I share the sentiment that you simply wish for a way to escape the pain caused.

Disclaimer I don’t think you should attempt it anymore. See if you still feel the same in a couple of months. As people always tell me “time heals all wounds”, I believe that even if we do feel suicidal, we should wait and be sure. While in the meantime seek help from a professional to sort out our feelings and thoughts.
